name: Berendezés azonosító
definition: Equipment and model identifier
notes: Model-specific product retrieval required.

name: Hőteljesítmény
definition: Available thermal heating capacity at an operating point
notes: Operating-point source data required; no generic scaling.

name: Teljes egység villamos input
definition: Whole heat-pump unit electrical input at an operating point
notes: Compressor-only input is not accepted as total system input.

name: Operating-point COP
definition: Useful thermal output divided by total unit electrical input
notes: Derived only when two source-supported values exist.

name: COP kerekítési tolerancia
definition: Explicit absolute tolerance for consistency checks on displayed source values
notes: 0.05 absolute COP tolerance for two-decimal manufacturer tables; larger mismatch fails validation.

name: Minimum modulation
definition: Source-native minimum thermal modulation capacity at an explicitly identified product and operating coordinate
notes: P22 supersedes the narrow Mitsubishi P21 source set for current surface use with an official exact-model Data Book Min grid: 40 source-native minimum-capacity points across a 27-cell piecewise bounded domain. Exact rows are OBS; interior floor values are DER only inside complete cells.

name: Külső hőmérséklet
definition: Canonical hourly outdoor temperature projected from source-native HungaroMet ta
notes: ta is the previous-hour mean and remains OBS in the source layer; no imputation or silent t/ta substitution.

name: Térfűtési hőigény
definition: Externally supplied hourly space-heating demand
notes: B02/B06 interface; no floor-area-only inference.

name: HMV hőigény
definition: Externally supplied hourly domestic-hot-water demand
notes: Separate from space heating.

name: Előremenő hőmérséklet
definition: Required supply-water temperature
notes: Low/medium/high cases are explicit scenarios

name: Backup hatásfok
definition: Explicit backup thermal-to-electric efficiency
notes: Only usable when backup is explicitly enabled and labelled.

name: Defrost modell státusza
definition: Whether evidence-backed weather-driven defrost runtime model is available
notes: P14 resolves EN14511 point-accounting semantics but not event frequency/duration/heat/electricity as a function of weather and controls.

name: Defrost elszámolási határ
definition: For explicitly EN14511-tagged points defrost effects occurring within the rating interval are part of heating-capacity/effective-input accounting
notes: P14: EN14511_RATED_POINT -> NO_EXTRA_UNIVERSAL_DEFROST_PENALTY. This does not assert that every point experienced an actual defrost event; unknown test basis remains Q and NIBE P10 continuous curves explicitly exclude defrost.

name: Defrost runtime penalty
definition: Separate weather-driven heat-pump electricity or heat penalty attributable to defrost
notes: No evidence-backed Hungarian/product-specific weather-driven penalty is applied. Vaillant UK 12-15% design allowance is context only and forbidden as national transfer.

name: Mért Cdh
definition: Product-specific certified or regulated-product cycling degradation coefficient on a measurement-determined EN14825 basis
notes: P22 adds same-product Mitsubishi PUZ-WM50VHA(-BS) exact low-temperature average-climate Cdh bins: -7=0.99, +2=0.98, +7=0.95, +12=0.93. Values are product/climate/application/Tj specific and are not interpolated or used as a universal hourly multiplier.

name: Regulatory Cdh default
definition: Regulatory default degradation coefficient when Cdh is not determined by measurement
notes: Cdh=0.9 is a compliance-method default only; never an OBS product value or automatic runtime penalty.

name: Cycling runtime penalty
definition: Separate B05 hourly efficiency correction attributable to below-minimum-modulation cycling
notes: P18 resolves numeric method authority for to-water cycling with the EN14825-based COPbin formula, but product-specific runtime remains Q until COPd is source-supported at the same cycling/minimum capacity used for CR. No nominal/Pdh-point COP substitution.

name: Szezonális szimulált COP
definition: Useful heat delivered by heat pump divided by heat-pump electricity
notes: Not an EN 14825 declared SCOP.

name: Szimulált SPF
definition: Useful heat including backup divided by total electricity
notes: Boundary explicitly includes backup when enabled.

name: Órás villamos csúcs
definition: Maximum hourly average electrical power
notes: Not instantaneous or sub-hourly start peak.

name: Kapacitáshiány
definition: Required thermal capacity minus heat-pump and explicit backup capacity
notes: Non-negative and separately auditable.

name: Órás leadott hő
definition: Hourly useful heat delivered by heat pump and explicit backup
notes: Power multiplied by explicit timestep; backup remains separate in the output ledger.

name: Órás hőszivattyú-villamos energia
definition: Hourly electricity consumed by the heat pump
notes: Total-unit input boundary.

name: Órás backup-villamos energia
definition: Hourly electricity consumed by explicit backup
notes: Zero when backup is disabled.

name: Órás összes villamos energia
definition: Hourly heat-pump plus backup electricity
notes: No tariff conversion inside B05.

name: Magyar 1-in-10 és extrém hideg bizonyíték
definition: Authoritative Hungarian definition and series for cold scenarios
notes: Observed 72-hour event exists; official 1-in-10 return-period definition remains Q and synthetic scenario labels remain SCN.

name: ta órás átlaghőmérséklet
definition: Source-native previous-hour mean air temperature
notes: Canonical B05 weather projection input; UTC timestamp preserved.

name: t pillanatnyi hőmérséklet
definition: Source-native hourly instantaneous air temperature
notes: Kept distinct from ta; not used as canonical hourly energy temperature.

name: u pillanatnyi relatív nedvesség
definition: Source-native instantaneous relative humidity
notes: Preserved for future defrost evidence; no defrost penalty in P3.

name: Cycling capacity ratio
definition: Required heat load divided by the exact cycling capacity used for the degradation method
notes: P18: require 0<CR<1 and a cycling capacity already qualified by P16/P17. CR is not market weighting and does not authorize modulation-floor interpolation.

name: COP at cycling capacity
definition: Source-supported COPd explicitly paired to the same product/coordinate/capacity used as the cycling-capacity denominator
notes: P22 materially expands same-point evidence: the official Mitsubishi Min table pairs minimum capacity and COP at all 40 exact materialized grid points, and bounded complete-cell interior minimum-point COP can be DER under the existing interpolation contract. Generic status remains Q outside this product/domain and where Cdh hourly-temperature mapping is unqualified.

name: Cycling-adjusted COP
definition: EN14825-based to-water COPbin after Cdh/CR adjustment at a qualified cycling point
notes: P22 creates four exact same-product W35 cycling-ready temperature bins (-7,+2,+7,+12 C) with source-native minimum capacity/COP and non-default Cdh. Generic hourly value remains Q between/beyond those Cdh bins until CDH_HOURLY_TEMPERATURE_MAPPING_REQUIRED is resolved.

name: Cycling input co-location status
definition: Whether exact modulation floor, point-paired COPd and qualified product Cdh coexist for the same product and operating coordinate
notes: P22 extends exact co-location from one P20 point to four exact W35 EN14825 temperature bins on PUZ-WM50VHA(-BS). Generic status remains Q for arbitrary hourly temperatures and other products.

name: Modulation-floor surface
definition: Bounded same-product minimum continuous heating-output surface derived only inside complete rectangular sets of source-native floor corners
notes: P22 current Mitsubishi surface: core A-10..A20 x W35..W55 plus cold shoulder A-15..A-10 x W35..W45 and extreme shoulder A-20..A-15 x W35..W40. Exact corners are OBS; complete-cell interiors are bounded bilinear DER; missing source cells remain Q.

name: Minimum-point COP surface
definition: Same-product COP at the source-native minimum heating-capacity operating point, with bounded bilinear DER only inside complete Data Book cells
notes: P22 materializes 40 exact PUZ-WM50VHA(-BS) minimum-capacity/COP pairs and permits coordinate-bounded interpolation of both fields only within 27 complete grid cells. No blank-cell filling or cross-product transfer.
